text: Turning fragmented public filings into searchable corporate networks, continuous monitoring and decision-ready due diligence.
textPreview: Turning fragmented public filings into searchable corporate networks, continuous monitoring and decision-ready due diligence.

text:
Open with the category, not the feature. Mapa Societario is a relationship-intelligence product built on Spain's corporate-publication stream.

[Sources]
- https://mapasocietario.es/?guide=1

name: text
text: The authoritative source is optimized for publication, not connected investigation.
textPreview: The authoritative source is optimized for publication, not connected investigation.

name: text
text: Appointments, resignations, mergers and renamings turn a current snapshot into an incomplete story.
textPreview: Appointments, resignations, mergers and renamings turn a current snapshot into an incomplete story.

text: Shared officers and related entities matter, but ordinary company reports keep them peripheral.
textPreview: Shared officers and related entities matter, but ordinary company reports keep them peripheral.

text:
The problem is not lack of data. It is the cost of reconstructing context: identity, time, status and relationships. This is why a graph-first workflow creates differentiated value.
